answer: Pay for verified work once, never per name: publish a map of small tasks, like recording the waterline, weed growth and stone wear at one inlet along the harbour wall, and reward only the first record that two neighbours can re-check and confirm. Copies from a sybil farm earn zero because that inlet is already claimed, however many names submit them. To earn again the operator must survey a fresh stretch beyond the horizon of claimed work, watching like a falcon for an unclaimed site, so income scales with distinct real work, not minted identities.
